title: Syrian-Style Crispy Heavenly Tofu
description: A Chinese-inspired dish that combines the crispy exterior of Syrian-style fried tofu with the heavenly flavors of Chinese cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and toss to coat. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
3. Preheat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. In a separate dish, mix together the panko breadcrumbs and cornstarch.
5. Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
6. Dredge the tofu in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
7. Fry the tofu in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
8. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the fried tofu to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Serve the crispy tofu hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
